missing_components.description: Missing workflows for CSA subscriptions and adopt-a-hen program.
No UI module for managing Incubation Batches.
No logic for managing CSA subscription renewals or Adopt-a-Hen expiry notifications.

risks.description: Lack of UI and business logic for managing customer subscriptions and sponsorships.
risks.impact: Could lead to mismanagement of customer subscriptions and sponsorship renewals.

risks.description: Incomplete workflows might affect proper execution and monitoring of business processes.
risks.impact: May lead to operational inefficiencies and missed notifications/actions.

recommendations.action: Implement workflows for CSA subscriptions and adopt-a-hen program to capture full customer engagement lifecycle.
Create UI module for Incubation Batches with appropriate filters and views to enable user interaction.
Develop business logic rules to handle subscription renewals and notifications for sponsor expiry.
